info.title: SpeechNexus public speech API
info.description:
SpeechNexus public speech protocol.

The OpenAI-compatible subset is limited to the paths, fields, formats, and
events explicitly declared here. A standard OpenAI SDK can use this API by
setting base_url to <deployment>/v1 and supplying any api_key value unless
the deployment enables a shared service key. SpeechNexus enhancements live
under /v1/nexus and the optional `nexus` request field; a standard request
never needs an enhancement wrapper. Unsupported standard parameters are
rejected with 422 `unsupported_parameter`, never silently ignored.

Realtime has two connection modes at GET /v1/realtime: a pre-created
nexus session (`session_id`) and a compatibility transcription session
opened with `model`. Both accept the declared standard transcription
event subset. TTS, previews, metadata, and operation coordination remain
nexus.* events and are available only in a nexus-created session.

post.summary: Create a voice-design draft and generation job

503.description:
`voice_draft_unavailable`: storage failed before any definite
commit, so retrying the same request is safe. The operation is
implemented; this is a retryable outage, not a permanently
unimplemented operation.

`voice_draft_outcome_unknown`: the submission may have committed
but its acknowledgement was lost. This code is returned only for a
request that carried its original Idempotency-Key; retry with that
exact key so the committed draft is replayed instead of creating a
second draft and generation Job. Do not retry with a new key.

get.summary: Get a voice draft and optional revision
get.description:
Returns the draft head and its current revision. The optional
draft_revision query selects an exact revision: a value that is not the
stored head is answered with 404 instead of silently returning a
different revision.

503.description:
The deployment has no voice draft storage or the stored result is
unavailable. The operation is implemented; this 503 is a retryable
outage, not a permanently unimplemented operation.

patch.description:
Only display metadata is mutable. Changing the voice description, sample,
reference text, preview text, or binding requires a new generation
revision and returns 422 for PATCH.

503.description:
The deployment has no voice draft storage or the stored result is
unavailable. The operation is implemented; this 503 is a retryable
outage, not a permanently unimplemented operation.

post.summary: Create the next draft revision and generation job
post.description:
Compares the expected head revision, allocates the next revision, and
commits the revision, job, and outbox atomically. Reusing an idempotency
key replays the original intent even if the head has advanced.

202.description: Next revision and generation job accepted.

503.description:
`voice_draft_unavailable`: storage failed before any definite
commit, so retrying the same request is safe. The operation is
implemented; this is a retryable outage, not a permanently
unimplemented operation.

`voice_draft_outcome_unknown`: the revision submission may have
committed but its acknowledgement was lost. This code is returned
only for a request that carried its original Idempotency-Key; retry
with that exact key so the committed revision and Job are replayed
instead of appending a second revision. Do not retry with a new key.

post.summary: Publish a validated draft revision as an immutable voice revision
post.description:
The first publication creates voice_id; later publications append an
immutable revision to the same voice_id. A stale head, stale validation,
or expired qualification returns 409/422. Replaying the same intent
returns the original publication.

200.description: Idempotent replay of the same publication.

503.description: `voice_draft_unavailable`: the validation report, its evidence, or publication storage is unavailable before any definite commit, so replaying the same request is safe. The operation is implemented; this is a retryable outage, not a permanently unimplemented operation. A recorded eligibility rejection is 422 instead.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description:
Optional idempotency key. The scope is (deployment_id, workspace_id,
operation_family, key). Standard OpenAI clients may omit it.

External_shared_identifiers_schema_json_.description: Opaque stable resource identifier. Prefixes are descriptive, not authorization claims.
Monotonic decimal revision represented as a string.

receipt_id.description: For an artifact referenced by a succeeded Job result, this must be present and equal the result receipt_id.

JobResult.description:
Structured successful outcome of a durable Job. `kind` must equal the
owning Job kind. Artifact identifiers in the result must identify the
corresponding entries in `Job.artifacts` with the matching kind and
result receipt; the service validates that cross-array identity before
committing `succeeded`.

publication_eligible.description: True only when every required check passed and the candidate has a verified reusable path to later TTS. Preview-only candidates are never publication eligible.

required.description: A skipped or failed required check makes the candidate publication-ineligible.

External_shared_errors_schema_json_Opera.description: Query GET /v1/nexus/operations/{operation_id}. This identity is the original execution; retrying never creates a second execution.

External_shared_receipts_schema_json_Pub.description: Allowlisted public projection only. Omit content, prompt, instructions, vendor payloads and private runtime identities. Unknown facts go into stable missing/unknown paths, never arbitrary dictionaries.

source_use_confirmed.description: Records the caller's explicit use confirmation for this submission. It is not identity verification, independent authorization, or dual review.

validation_job_id.description: Succeeded durable Job that produced validation. Must equal VoiceDraftRevision.validation_job_id and the Job that returned this validation as its structured result.

manual_confirmation.description: Records explicit content confirmation for this publication. It does not prove a second reviewer or a role-based approval.

XRequestId.description: Validated client request ID or a server-generated correlation ID.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before retrying a capacity or cancellation coordination request.

BadRequest.description: Malformed request, invalid JSON, invalid audio, or unknown field.

Unauthorized.description: Shared service credential required or invalid.

Forbidden.description: Origin/Host policy rejected the request or the feature is disabled.

MethodNotAllowed.description:
The registered path does not accept this HTTP method. `Allow` lists every
method registered on that path template, including placeholder methods.
The Job paths keep their own `job_method_not_allowed` code.

VoiceDraftCreationConflict.description:
`voice_draft_conflict`: the Idempotency-Key identifies another intent,
or the metadata revision conflicts.

`voice_draft_outcome_unknown`: the creation request did not carry an
Idempotency-Key and an earlier submission may already have committed.
A resubmission is a new intent and can create a second draft and
generation Job, so this reply is not retryable: reconcile the original
request before deciding to submit again.

UnprocessableEntity.description: Unsupported parameter, incompatible profile, or async_required.

TooManyRequests.description: Quota or queue limit exceeded; follow Retry-After.

VoiceDraftContractViolation.description:
The deployment produced a voice draft response that violates this
contract, or the storage rejected a voice draft write deterministically
(a CHECK or constraint refusal). The operation is implemented and the
storage is reachable, so both are implementation defects rather than an
outage: they are not retryable and repeating the request cannot succeed
until they are fixed. A response-shape violation is not an outage, and
a deterministic storage refusal is neither a client conflict nor a
transient storage failure. The reply still uses the public error
envelope.

NotFound.description: Resource not found or not visible to the requested workspace.

Conflict.description:
Configuration changed, idempotency conflict, operation in progress, or cleanup pending.
operation_in_progress requires error.nexus.operation_id for querying the original
execution. response_not_replayable additionally requires error.nexus.receipt and
never starts another execution. Query GET /v1/nexus/operations/{operation_id}.

SharedServiceKey.description:
Optional deployment-wide shared credential. It grants access to the
shared deployment, not a user identity. When disabled, any Authorization
header value is accepted for SDK compatibility and is not interpreted as
a user.
